title: 307 The Office - Small Talk Series - Showing Interest

content.text: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 你好，大家和欢迎来到英语播客。我的名字是马克。

content.text: My name is Catherine and today we're talking about a very, very important part of conversations
content.trans: 我的名字是凯特，今天我们要讨论的是一个非常重要的话题。

content.text: in English.
content.trans: 在英语中。

content.text: That's right. Today we are introducing a new series all about small talk.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Okay. What is small talk Marco?
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我关于小谈的更多细节。

content.text: Well small talk is just everyday conversation about maybe the weather, about how you are,
content.trans: 英语：嗯，小话题就是每天和你聊聊天气、你最近过得怎么样之类的吧。

content.text: what's new in your life, etc. It's just plain conversation.
content.trans: 英语：你最近有什么新鲜事，等等。它只是日常对话。

content.text: So something very simple and usually pretty quick. It's what you say to people when you bump
content.trans: 英语：所以，简单到让人难以置信。当你和别人交谈时，你总是说得很流畅。

content.text: into them or when you see them at a party. So let's take a listen to today's dialogue
content.trans: 英语：进入他们或在聚会时听到他们的对话。所以让我们听听今天的对话。

content.text: and find out just what kind of small talk we have.
content.trans: 和找出我们有什么小谈。

content.text: Hey Michelle, this is my friend James. He's visiting Shanghai from New York.
content.trans: 你好，梅丽莎！这是我朋友杰克。他今天从纽约飞往上海。

content.text: Oh hi James, nice to meet you. So are you visiting for business or pleasure?
content.trans: 英语：你好，杰克，很高兴见到你。你是商务旅行还是休闲活动？

content.text: Well actually a little of both. I'm meeting some business contacts but I'm also taking
content.trans: 英语：实际上，这是一点半。我正在参加一些商业联系，同时也在处理一些业务事务。

content.text: some Mandarin classes too.
content.trans: 一些 Mandarin 课程。

content.text: Oh that's cool. How's it going?
content.trans: 英语：哦，那个不错。怎么样呢？

content.text: Well I'm finding the classes pretty tough actually. But I'm having a great time in Shanghai.
content.trans: 英语：它是个傻瓜相机。我在上海找课程，挺难的。

content.text: It's really an amazing city.
content.trans: 它真的是一幅美丽的城市。

content.text: It sure is. Are you staying for long?
content.trans: 是的，你打算待多久呢？

content.text: Only two weeks unfortunately. I wish I could stay longer but...
content.trans: 对不起，我只能呆两天。我希望我能再待一会儿，但...

content.text: Well listen, if you need someone to show you the sights then just call me.
content.trans: 英语：如果你需要有人带你看看世界，就直接打电话给我吧。

content.text: I'm having a little get together at my new apartment next week.
content.trans: 我下周在新公寓聚会。

content.text: So if you want to drop by then...
content.trans: 所以如果你想来的话...

content.text: That sounds great. I'd love to. Let me take down your number Michelle.
content.trans: 听起来不错。我乐意。让我记住你的电话号码，Michelle。

content.text: Alright we're back so now let's take a look at a lot of great phrases that we've picked out for you this time on Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 流畅 builder.

content.text: Alright so I've got two Fluency Builders today so we're going to be exploring a lot of different phrases.
content.trans: 好的，今天我有两套流利表达器，所以我们今天将探讨很多不同的短语。

content.text: We've got three now. The first one is very very common. You hear this phrase. Nice to meet you.
content.trans: 我们有三台。第一台非常常见，你听到这个短语了。很高兴见到你。

content.text: Right so obviously if you meet someone new you're introduced by your friend or something.
content.trans: 英语：如果你遇到一个新朋友，你可以向他们介绍自己。

content.text: You can just say hi. Nice to meet you.
content.trans: 你好，可以直说吗？很高兴遇见你。

content.text: Alright so nice to meet you. Nice to meet you too. That's what we say afterwards because it sounds very funny if you say it two times.
content.trans: 好的，很高兴见到你。也很高兴见到你。我们说以后会这样，因为听起来如果你说了两次，感觉很有趣。

content.text: Right. Hi it's nice to meet you. Oh it's nice to meet you too.
content.trans: 正确。你好，很高兴见到你。也一样很高兴见到你。

content.text: Right exactly. So she went on this girl Michelle to ask if he is visiting Shanghai for business or pleasure.
content.trans: 正确翻译：她直接去了这个女孩Michelle，问她是否正在上海出差或享受生活。

content.text: Alright this is an important difference something that we often talk about in small talk.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: You can travel for business that means business trips.
content.trans: 你可以在商务旅行中自由地移动。

content.text: Or you can travel to see different sites and have fun that's called pleasure.
content.trans: 英语：或者你可以去体验不同的景点并享受乐趣。

content.text: And so we often hear this phrase business or pleasure.
content.trans: 而且我们常常听到这句话“生意或乐趣”。

content.text: Right so if someone comes to your country you say oh sorry you hear for business or pleasure.
content.trans: 英语：如果你来中国，你可以说“啊，抱歉，听说你有生意或者闲情。”

content.text: Oh I'm here on business or I'm here to see the sites.
content.trans: 英语：哦，我在出差或来参观网站。

content.text: Okay very good. And so James is actually in Shanghai doing both things.
content.trans: 好的，很好。而且詹姆斯实际上在上海同时进行这两件事。

content.text: He's on a business trip but he's also taking Mandarin classes and so Michelle went on to say that's great.
content.trans: 他正在出差，但他还是在学习中文和英语，所以Michelle说那是很好的。

content.text: How's it going?
content.trans: 英语：如何？

content.text: Alright you're going to hear this all the time in English.
content.trans: 英语：你每次都会听到这个所有的。

content.text: We say how's it going to our friends and family.
content.trans: 我们说怎么样，你们的朋友们和家人过得怎么样。

content.text: I wouldn't say it in a formal occasion with my boss or with my teacher but it's very casual, very informal.
content.trans: 我不会在正式场合或老师面前说这句话，但它是非常随意的、很轻松的。

content.text: And it's a way to ask how things are.
content.trans: 而且是问事情是如何的。

content.text: Right. So you're taking classes? How's it going?
content.trans: 是的，你正在学习？进展如何？

content.text: Exactly. So this basically means how are the classes going? How is everything?
content.trans: 是的。所以这个基本上意味着课程如何进展？一切顺利吗？

content.text: Right or you could say oh Marco I haven't seen you in a while. How is it going?
content.trans: 英语：对，你也可以这么说，Marco。最近过得怎么样？

content.text: Uh huh and that's another way of saying hi to someone or saying how are you?
content.trans: 英语：哦，对了，还有这个“你好”怎么说呢？

content.text: How are you? How have you been recently?
content.trans: 你好，最近怎么样？

content.text: So there are two differences in that phrase there.
content.trans: 英语：所以那句话里有两点区别。

content.text: In this case Michelle is asking how the Mandarin classes are going. How is it?
content.trans: 在这种情况里，米歇尔正在询问 Mandarin 课程的情况。她怎么样？

content.text: Is it good? Is it bad? Is it difficult? Is it is it easy?
content.trans: 英语：是吗？好还是不好？难不难？容易吗？

content.text: etc. But if you say to someone hi I haven't seen you for such a long time.
content.trans: 英语：等等，但我听说你很久没有见到我了。

content.text: How's it going? That's more of a how are you type thing?
content.trans: 英语：如何？这是你最近的进展吗？

content.text: That's like how's your life going?
content.trans: 这个像你生活怎么样？

content.text: Exactly. So just think about what the what what you're talking about.
content.trans: 正确。那么就想想你正在讨论的什么。

content.text: Are you talking about general situations like your person a person's life?
content.trans: 是吗，您是在谈论您的个人生活还是您的家人或朋友的情况？

content.text: Or are you talking about maybe lessons or class or a job?
content.trans: 英语：或者你可能是在谈论课或实习或工作。

content.text: That's right. Okay so we're going to take a break here.
content.trans: 英语：那对了。那么我们今天就休息一下。

content.text: Let's listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back in a little bit with more phrases.
content.trans: 让我们再次听对话，然后在稍后与更多短语会面。

content.text: Hey Michelle this is my friend James.
content.trans: 你好，梅丽莎，这是我的朋友詹姆斯。

content.text: He's visiting Shanghai from New York.
content.trans: 他正在从纽约飞往上海。

content.text: Oh hi James nice to meet you.
content.trans: 你好，詹姆斯，很高兴见到你。

content.text: So are you visiting for business or pleasure?
content.trans: 英语：所以你出差还是度假？

content.text: Well actually a little of both. I'm meeting some business contacts but I'm also taking some Mandarin classes too.
content.trans: 英语：实际上，我正在学习一些中文。我正在参加一些商务会议，但我也在学习一些汉语。

content.text: Oh that's cool. How's it going?
content.trans: 英语：哦，那真是太棒了。怎么样呢？

content.text: Well I'm finding the classes pretty tough actually.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我感觉这门课挺难的。

content.text: But I'm having a great time in Shanghai. It's really an amazing city.
content.trans: 但是我在上海度过了一个愉快的假期。真是个令人惊叹的城市。

content.text: It sure is. Are you staying for long?
content.trans: 是的，你打算待多久呢？

content.text: Only two weeks unfortunately. I wish I could stay longer but...
content.trans: 对不起，我只能呆两天。我想再待一会儿，但...

content.text: Well listen if you need someone to show you the sights then just call me.
content.trans: 英语：如果你需要有人带你看看这里的风景，那么就直接给我打电话吧。

content.text: I'm having a little get together at my new apartment next week.
content.trans: 我下周在新公寓聚会。

content.text: So if you want to drop by then.
content.trans: 所以，如果你想来的话。

content.text: That sounds great. I'd love to. Let me take down your number Michelle.
content.trans: 英语：那听起来不错。我非常乐意。让我卸下你的电话号码，Michelle。

content.text: Alright we're back so now let's take a look at Fluency Builder part two.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请将需要翻译的英文内容提供给我，我会尽力准确地将其翻译成简化中文。

content.text: So Michelle at the end of today's dialogue says if you need someone to show you the sights then just call me.
content.trans: 所以，今天下午的对话中，如果需要有人带你看看风景，就直接打电话给我吧。

content.text: Alright so to show someone the sights we talked about this a little bit earlier with that word pleasure.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: What does it mean to show someone the sights Marco?
content.trans: 英语：它意味着展示给马克看的风景。

content.text: So basically the sights we're talking about the different attractions of a city or place.
content.trans: 所以，基本上我们谈论的是一个城市或地方的不同景点。

content.text: So the museums maybe different buildings or different attractions in general.
content.trans: 所以博物馆的建筑或景点可能不同。

content.text: What is there to sight see?
content.trans: 什么值得一看？

content.text: Okay so we are in Paris Marco and I say hey I love to show you the sights.
content.trans: 好的，我们现在在巴黎。马克，你好！我非常喜欢带你看看这里的风景。

content.text: What do you expect to see?
content.trans: 您期望看到什么？

content.text: So maybe we would go to the Eiffel Tower.
content.trans: 英语：所以或许我们去埃菲尔铁塔吧。

content.text: Maybe we would go to...
content.trans: 英语：也许我们会去...

content.text: Notre Dame Cathedral.
content.trans: 巴黎圣母院

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: So we would go see all these different sights and to show and that would mean that you are showing me the sights.
content.trans: 所以我们都会去看这些不同的风景，并且这表示你正在展示给我看这些风景。

content.text: You are taking me to see all these sights.
content.trans: 你正在把我带往这些美景。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: And she is also having a little get together at her apartment at her new apartment.
content.trans: 英语：她还邀请了她的新公寓里的朋友们参加聚会。

content.text: So what is a little get together?
content.trans: 所以，一个小小的聚会是什么意思？

content.text: This is a noun.
content.trans: 这个是名词。

content.text: This is a get together so think about this two different words actually get together.
content.trans: 这个是聚餐，所以想想这两个不同的词，实际上聚餐。

content.text: But it's a noun.
content.trans: 但是它是一个名词。

content.text: It's a thing.
content.trans: 这是个点和拍。

content.text: It's like a party.
content.trans: 是聚会。

content.text: But it's a small party.
content.trans: 但是这是一次小型聚会。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: A little get together.
content.trans: A小聚。

content.text: So I just...
content.trans: 所以，我只是...

content.text: I like to think of a get together as something very casual, something very small.
content.trans: 英语：我喜欢把一个聚会比喻为非常随意、非常小的活动。

content.text: Sometimes intimate.
content.trans: Sometimes亲密。

content.text: Where you just have three or four or five friends.
content.trans: 你只需要有三到五个朋友。

content.text: And it's...
content.trans: 和它一样...

content.text: Yeah, it's not as big as a party where everyone is dancing.
content.trans: 是的，它不像一个聚会，每个人都正在跳舞。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So a little get together is just a small group of people you invite them over to your house.
content.trans: 所以，一个小型聚会只是邀请你来我家玩的小团体。

content.text: Very relaxed, very casual.
content.trans: 非常放松，非常随意。

content.text: It's not really a party.
content.trans: 是的，这是一个玩笑。

content.text: It's more of a reunion of friends.
content.trans: 它是朋友间的聚会。

content.text: And like we said, it's a noun.
content.trans: 而且像我们刚才说的，它是一个名词。

content.text: So you say, I'm having a get together.
content.trans: 英语：所以你说，我有聚会。

content.text: You should come.
content.trans: 你应当来。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: And she actually asks them to come.
content.trans: 英语：她实际上要求他们来。

content.text: But she says it in a different way.
content.trans: 但是她说的方式不同。

content.text: She says, if you want to drop by.
content.trans: 她说，如果你想来。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: This is something people often say in small talk.
content.trans: 这个是人们在小talk中经常说的。

content.text: Because you don't want to say, you should come stay for a while.
content.trans: 因为你想等一下，你最好来一趟。

content.text: Because that's...
content.trans: 因为那...

content.text: I don't know.
content.trans: 我不会。

content.text: They just...
content.trans: 他们只是...。

content.text: It's not in order.
content.trans: 不是在顺序。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: So if you're talking on the phone and I say, I'll drop by your house later on today.
content.trans: 所以如果你今天打电话，我可能会在你家附近等你。

content.text: That means I'm going to go to your house very quickly at an unexpected moment.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：

content.text: So I'm going to go back to my house.
content.trans: 所以我要回去我家了。

content.text: I'm going to go back to my house.
content.trans: 我将回到我家。

content.text: I'm going to go back to my house.
content.trans: 我将回到我家。

content.text: And today that means I'm going to go to your house very quickly at an unexpected time.
content.trans: 今天，我将飞快地去你家，因为今天的情况让我非常不确定。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Or you could use it in a question.
content.trans: 英语：或者你可以在问题中使用它。

content.text: Marco, I really wanted to borrow that DVD.
content.trans: 英语：Marco，我想借那张DVD给你。

content.text: When can I drop by to pick it up?
content.trans: 当能来取一下吗？

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Very, very good.
content.trans: 非常棒。

content.text: Now let's take a look at our last phrase.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Michelle and James decided that they want to keep in touch.
content.trans: 英语：米歇尔和杰克决定他们想保持联系。

content.text: And so he said, let me take down your number.
content.trans: 然后他说，让我把你的号码摘下来。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So we're not talking about...
content.trans: 所以我们不是...

content.text: Taking it anywhere.
content.trans: 随时随地拍照。

content.text: Taking a number anywhere and going somewhere.
content.trans: 英语：任何地方都可以拍摄，到处都去。

content.text: We're talking about writing something down.
content.trans: 我们正在讨论一下写点什么。

content.text: So in this case, your number is your phone number.
content.trans: 所以，在这种情况下，你的号码就是你的电话号码。

content.text: Mm-hmm.
content.trans: 英语：嗯。

content.text: Okay, let me take down your number means let me write down your telephone number.
content.trans: 好的，让我把你的电话号码记录下来。

content.text: Uh-huh.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，对。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So it's another way of saying, let me write down your telephone number.
content.trans: 所以，它又是一种表达方式，让我把你的电话号码写下来。

content.text: Take down my phone number.
content.trans: 取消我的电话号码。

content.text: Call me later.
content.trans: 再见。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 正确。

content.text: So can I take down your number so I can call you later?
content.trans: 所以，我可以卸下你的任务，以便我可以在你之后联系你。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: That's another way of asking this question.
content.trans: 这个另一个方式是这样问这个问题。

content.text: Very good.
content.trans: 非常棒。

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So that concludes Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 所以，Fluency Builder 结束了。

content.text: Let's listen to our dialogue one last time.
content.trans: 让我们再听一次我们的对话。

content.text: And we'll be back in a bit.
content.trans: 我们很快就会回来的。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Hey Michelle, this is my friend James.
content.trans: 你好，梅丽莎，这是我的朋友詹姆斯。

content.text: He's visiting Shanghai from New York.
content.trans: 他正在从纽约飞往上海。

content.text: Oh, hi James.
content.trans: 英语：你好，杰克。

content.trans: 你好，很高兴见到你。

content.text: So, um, are you visiting for business or pleasure?
content.trans: 英语：所以，呃，你今天是出差还是度假？

content.text: Well, actually a little of both.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：

content.text: I'm meeting some business contacts, but I'm also taking some Mandarin classes too.
content.trans: 我正在参加一些商业联系，但我也在学习一些中文。

content.trans: 英语：哦，那真是太棒了。

content.trans: 英语：如何？

content.text: Well, I'm finding the classes pretty tough actually.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我遇到的课程确实挺难的。

content.text: But I'm having a great time in Shanghai.
content.trans: 但是我在上海度过了愉快的时光。

content.text: It's really an amazing city.
content.trans: 它真是个美丽的城市。

content.text: It sure is.
content.trans: 它确实如此。

content.text: Are you staying for long?
content.trans: 是的，你打算待多久？

content.text: Only two weeks unfortunately.
content.trans: 不幸的是，只有两周。

content.text: I wish I could stay longer, but...
content.trans: 我希望能再多待一会儿，但...

content.text: Well, listen, if you need someone to show you the sights, then just call me.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，听明白了，如果你需要有人带你看看风景的话，那就直接打电话给我吧。

content.text: I'm having a little get together at my new apartment next week.
content.trans: 我下周在新公寓聚会。

content.text: So if you want to drop by then...
content.trans: 所以如果你想过来的话...

content.text: That sounds great.
